notes.title: Tiny Update (29/4/25)
notes.content:
A small update for bug fixes and QOL changes:

[list]
[*] Fixed overzealous progression achievements (affected users of MORSE cheat code)
[*] Fixed spaces not working in editor (you couldn't make custom sentences)
[*] Made Play and Edit buttons auto-subscribe you in the editor
[*] Added Loading and end-of-page labels to the editor
[/list]

notes.title: Tiny Update (23/4/25)
notes.content:
The morse gods have polished your telegraph.

[list]
[*] Editor levels are now public by default
[*] Changing difficulty now increases your custom speed (visual improvement)
[*] Made endless mode more fun
[*] Fixed level-progression achievements for playtesters and cheat-code users
[*] Fixed a typo ('Brittania' -> 'Britannia')
[/list]
